raw_tokens.value: A storm dreamer can enter a meditative trance during which she fuses her mind to the Eye of Abendego, mentally becoming one with the great storm. Entering the trance is a full-round action that doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity, but once in a storm trance, the storm dreamer can maintain the trance as a free action for %1 minutes per day. These minutes need not be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments. While in a storm trance, the storm dreamer gains energy resistance 5 against cold and electricity, treats wind as one step less severe, and gains a +%2 bonus on all saving throws against wind effects, spells with the air or electricity descriptors, and effects that deal electricity damage.|MediumLVL+CHA|CHA
